01 / A local approach

YOUR HOME.
ALL CONNECTED.

One number for the leak under the sink today and the electrical panel or AC problem tomorrow.

CR Plumbing, Air & Electric is a licensed plumbing, electrical, and HVAC company serving Flower Mound, Texas. Full-service plumbing — including water heaters, septic repair, and AC and heating — handled by one local team with same-day emergency appointments usually available. Founded by a Master Plumber, rated 4.9★ on Google. Flower Mound homeowners deal with the same short list of problems on repeat: a water heater that finally gives out, a slow drain that’s been “fine for now” for six months, or an AC that picks the worst July afternoon to quit. CR Plumbing was built to be the one call that handles all of it — plumbing first, since that’s the trade the company was founded on, with electrical and HVAC under the same roof so you’re not juggling three contractors for one house.

From a tankless water heater that needs a gas connection to a home that needs better heating and cooling, start with the system that needs attention. Explore the service details below, or tell the team what is happening at your property.

05 / Questions from Flower Mound

GOOD TO
KNOW.

Ask the team ↗
Do you actually cover Flower Mound, or just list it?

We serve Flower Mound directly from the Cross Timbers Rd office — which is why same-day emergency service here is realistic, not a “we’ll try” promise.

Do you handle septic systems, not just city sewer?

Yes. Full-service plumbing here includes septic tank repair — a lot of Flower Mound properties still rely on septic, and not every plumbing company covers it.

Can one company really do plumbing, electrical, and HVAC?

Yes — licensed in all three, not a plumber dabbling. The advantage shows up on jobs that cross trades, like a tankless water heater needing gas and a dedicated circuit at once.

Do you provide emergency plumbing service in Flower Mound?

Yes. Same-day appointments are usually available for burst pipes, no hot water, and sewage or septic backups. Call (940) 370-5663.

What plumbing issues do you handle in Flower Mound homes?

Leaks, water heaters, drain and sewer lines, septic repair, repiping, fixtures, and gas lines. Full detail on the Flower Mound plumbing page.

Are your electricians and HVAC techs licensed, or is this mostly a plumbing shop?

All three trades are staffed by licensed technicians in their own trade.

Do you offer financing?

Yes, on qualifying work.

What areas near Flower Mound do you serve?

Flower Mound and nearby communities including Highland Village, Lewisville, Double Oak, Bartonville, and Copper Canyon.
